actions.name: create_csv_lines
actions.title: Compose CSV
actions.help: Compose a CSV formatted string from a list (array). Example output: line1_value1,line1_value2 line2_value1,line2_value2 line3_value1,line3_value2

input.name: column_labels
input.label: CSV column names
input.hint: Type in the column names of your CSV, one per line. This will generate additional input fields below.

input.name: create_header_line
input.label: Create header line
input.hint: If true , a header line will be created using the column names provided.

input.name: force_quotes
input.label: Force quotes
input.hint: When set to true, quote all values.

actions.name: parse_csv
actions.title: Parse CSV
actions.help: Parse CSV-formatted string into an array of lines. A maximum of 50000 lines can be converted. Learn more

input.name: col_sep
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The character that separates columns in the CSV contents.

input.name: skip_first_line
input.label: CSV contents contain header line?
input.hint: Set to Yes if the CSV contents contain a header line that should not be parsed.

input.name: header_line
input.label: Header line
input.hint: Paste an example header line here. Column names must be separated using the Column delimiter above.

input.name: column_value_by
input.label: Keep track of columns by
input.hint: Configure this if your expected CSV contents will not have fixed column order or column names: - If Column order is set: Your CSV contents must have fixed column order for recipe to work. Column names…

input.name: quote_char
input.label: Quote character
input.hint: Character used to quote the CSV cell values. Select None if no quote character is used.

input.name: enable_liberal_parsing
input.label: Enable liberal parsing
input.hint: Recovers from minor format issues and continue parsing instead of raising error. Use with caution as malformed data may be inaccurately parsed.

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.
